analysis:
Only CHANGELOG.md is visible: base lines 1381-1756 (older release notes) and head lines 1-234 (new and retained Unreleased entries). No source, test, or config diffs were supplied, so no concrete security regression is claimed. The head text adds prose for features whose code was not provided, and the next pass should check them against the real diffs.

(1) Autopilot daily earnings floor (CHANGELOG.md head lines 3-7): a new separately funded payment path touching A-009 and TB-008. It uses consent evidence, a frozen baseline, canonical-machine receipts, admin funding and repair endpoints (TB-006), and history_conflict holds. Review idempotency and double-pay across reconnects and aliases, admin authorization on funding, repair and backfill, and whether the baseline can be inflated by sponsored inference. Also check that consent is bound to authenticated evidence, which relates to T-055 and T-030-style duplicate-credit risks. The entry says existing accounting archives do not cover these tables, which is a retention gap, and payments default off.

(2) Machine diagnostics and machine-scoped Autopilot (lines 9-18): admin views expose per-session pins, resident models and hardware, so check for privacy leakage (T-058, T-051). Persisted per-machine Autopilot mode needs live-control authority tied to verified identity (TB-011, T-052, T-053).

(3) Soft-delete mutation gate and account erasure (lines 86-110, T-059) and caller-field minimization (line 234) match the existing threat model.

(4) Bedrock review and merge clearance (lines 30-38) is CI review-control surface. It is outside the production threat model but affects the PR gate.

The threat model may need new entries for the earnings floor and Autopilot financial surface once the code is reviewed. needs_deeper_review is true only because the code behind these entries was not supplied.
